notes: Translated Tables1-7.do (Tables I-III) to fixest. Variables standardized as egen std() over all non-missing rows of fascism_db.dta. Regiment (d_reg*) and province (province*) dummies entered as explicit regressors as in Stata reg/ivreg2 (collinear dummies dropped by feols); ivreg2's partial() does not change point estimates. SEs clustered by circondario1921. First-stage F for column 6 = (b/se)^2 from the clustered OLS first stage with Stata-style small-sample adjustment (the `test` after `reg, cl()`). attempt-1 was an exploratory variable inspection; attempt-2 crashed because circondario1921 is a string and was coerced to numeric NA; fixed by keeping it as character. No claim-feedback iterations were used.
